overview: The Resident Services and Public Engagement Committee met to finalize the June city council newsletter draft, assign drafting duties for upcoming newsletters, and plan logistics and outreach for upcoming neighborhood ward meetings.

items.title: City Council Newsletter Review
items.summary: The committee reviewed the draft June newsletter, discussing how to link specific ordinances and agreeing to include pavement and pothole repair statistics from the Department of Public Works.

items.title: Newsletter Drafting Schedule
items.summary: Committee members volunteered for future monthly newsletter drafting assignments running through December.

items.title: Neighborhood Ward Meetings Planning
items.summary: The committee discussed hybrid meeting logistics with Medford Community Media and brainstormed various digital and physical outreach strategies to publicize the upcoming ward meetings.

items.title: Noise Ordinance Update
items.summary: The chair noted that the noise ordinance was not on the current agenda due to notice requirements and will be addressed at the next meeting in mid-September.
